problem: Mike wants to work out five days a week. In how many ways can Mike choose five days to work out?
worked_solution:
The number of combinations of $n$ objects taken $r$ at a time is given by the formula

$$
{}_{n}{C}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!\,r!}.
$$

There are $7$ days in a week, so $n=7.$ We want to select $5$ of those days for Mike to workout, so we have $r=5.$

Therefore, the number of choices is

$$
\begin{aligned}{}_{7}{C}_{5} & =\frac{7!}{(7-5)!\,5!} \\  & =\frac{7!}{2!5!} \\  & =\frac{7\cdot 6\cdot \cancel{5!}}{2!\cancel{5!}} \\  & =\frac{7\cdot 6}{2\cdot 1} \\  & =\frac{42}{2} \\  & =21.\end{aligned}
$$
